notes: Sentinel 6.0.23: Pokemon Center queue detection starts before the queue - pre-queue signals trigger drop mode, faster 60s checks in drop windows, and an urgent alert if blocked during a drop. Target drops now push to your phone, and new drop products no longer get silently dropped for lack of a reference price. Missed-drop post-mortem tool included. Updates still install automatically, but never 6 AM-1 PM MST, during a queue, drop mode, or right after an alert.
